tracks.title: Two Cats, Zero Pounds (Genesis at 3 AM)
tracks.theme: The opening statement: 3 AM in the bedroom studio, overdraft warnings on the banking app, two cats sleeping across the gear, and the birth of a dream.

tracks.title: Feline Landlords on the Spacebar
tracks.theme: Every time David tries to hit play, the tabby walks across the transport controls. Swung boom-bap drums and warm Rhodes chops.

tracks.title: Overdraft Love Letter
tracks.theme: A soulful ballad addressed to the automated overdraft alerts on his phone. Melodic acoustic bass and tape-saturated harmonies.

tracks.title: Coffee Stains & Broken Preamps
tracks.theme: Electrical tape holding the audio interface together, cold instant coffee, and dusty vinyl crackle setting the groove.

tracks.title: Sent to an A&R's Ghost
tracks.theme: Dropping SoundCloud private links into unresponsive inboxes. Atmospheric electric piano and lonely late-night rain on the glass.

tracks.title: Tuna Can Grammys
tracks.theme: Stacking empty gourmet cat food cans into makeshift golden trophy shapes. Witty, syncopated boom-bap rhythm with muted trumpet.

tracks.title: Four Chords, Nine Lives
tracks.theme: Reflective and warm: when money is gone and the world is cold, nine feline lives and four soulful chords are all you need to survive.

tracks.title: The Space Between Paychecks (Interlude)
tracks.theme: Intimate solo upright piano with vintage tape flutter, purring background acoustics, and gentle rain outside.

tracks.title: Bedroom Platinum
tracks.theme: Who needs Abbey Road when you have an RTX 3070 Ti, closed-back headphones, and unwavering dedication? Punchy kick and fat sub bass.

tracks.title: Cat Hair on the Pop Filter
tracks.theme: Blowing cat fluff off the condenser capsule before tracking vocals. Playful, head-nodding lo-fi rhythm with jazzy guitar riffs.

tracks.title: Streaming for Pennies
tracks.theme: Calculating that 0.003 cents per stream means 10,000 plays to buy a bag of cat litter. Gritty humorous lyrics over gorgeous neo-soul chords.

tracks.title: 4 AM Epiphany
tracks.theme: That magical hour when the whole world sleeps and the perfect chorus melody drops straight out of the sky. Dreamy chorus delays and pads.

tracks.title: Whispering in the Mic (Don't Wake the Neighbors)
tracks.theme: Thin bedroom walls require soft-spoken ASMR-adjacent vocal delivery that accidentally sounds like a multi-platinum intimate masterpiece.

tracks.title: Bounced to MP3
tracks.theme: Exporting the final master at 320 kbps. Head-bobbing bounce, uplifting strings, and celebratory vocal ad-libs.

tracks.title: Two Little Purrs in the Monitor Mix
tracks.theme: Subtle feline purring embedded right into the low-end frequencies. The most comforting chillhop lullaby ever recorded.

tracks.title: Sunrise on the Interface (Outro)
tracks.theme: First morning light breaks through the blinds, illuminating the audio mixer. The cats wake up for breakfast. Another day, another masterpiece.
